title.en: History of Neolithic Age or New Stone Age
title.hi: History of नवपाषाण काल Age or New Stone Age

definition.en: The Neolithic Age represents the final phase of the Stone Age, characterized by the advent of settled agriculture, domestication of animals, and polished stone tools.
definition.hi: The नवपाषाण काल Age represents the final phase of the Stone Age, characterized by the advent of settled agriculture, domestication of animals, and polished stone tools.

importanceInUpsc.en: Crucial for UPSC Prelims due to factual questions on site locations, pottery types, and crop evidence. For GS-1 Mains, understanding this transition forms the foundational basis of the evolution of Indian society, economy, and early human settlement patterns.
importanceInUpsc.hi: Crucial for UPSC Prelims due to factual questions on site locations, pottery types, and crop evidence. For GS-1 Mains, understanding this transition forms the foundational basis of the evolution of Indian society, economy, and early human settlement patterns.
